name: B10-0043/2024 (Renew) – The case of José Daniel Ferrier García in Cuba
title: Resolution on the case of José Daniel Ferrer García in Cuba
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of José Daniel Ferrer García, a Cuban opposition leader held since July 2021. It says he is a prisoner of conscience kept in solitary confinement, in poor health and without family visits. The Parliament asks Cuba to free him and all others jailed for peaceful protest, to give him medical care and family access, and to stop repressing dissent. It also asks the European Union to consider sanctions and to review its cooperation agreement with Cuba.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament is asking, not deciding; Cuba and European Union governments must act.
- **Who it affects:** José Daniel Ferrer García, other Cuban political prisoners, and European Union relations with Cuba.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to Cuba, European Union bodies and others; no deadline or action is set.
